name: robolly
label: Robolly
description: Robolly is the all‑in‑one service for personalized image, video & PDF generation with API

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to [Robolly](https://robolly.com/dashboard/).
2. Open your project and go to **API**.
3. Copy the API key and paste it here.

robolly_list_templates.label: List Templates
robolly_list_templates.description: Lists the templates in your Robolly account.

robolly_list_template_elements.label: List Template Elements
robolly_list_template_elements.description: Lists a template's elements and the modifications each one accepts.

templateId.label: Template ID
templateId.description: The template ID, e.g. "6416bcbab241242aa0b22ecb". Use List Templates to find it.

robolly_create_template.label: Create Template
robolly_create_template.description: Creates a blank template in your Robolly account.

backgroundColor.label: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Canvas background color as a CSS color, e.g. "rgb(27, 61, 166)" or "#1b3da6".

path.label: Folder Path
path.description: An existing folder in the Robolly dashboard to list the template under. Robolly rejects a folder that does not exist.

renderFileName.label: Render File Name
renderFileName.description: The file name given to rendered files.

disallowNotSigned.label: Require Signed Render Links
disallowNotSigned.description: Yes rejects render links that have neither a signature nor an API key. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

robolly_render_template.label: Render Template
robolly_render_template.description: Renders a template as an image, PDF or MP4 and returns the file URL.

templateId.label: Template ID
templateId.description: The template ID, e.g. "6416bcbab241242aa0b22ecb". Use List Templates to find it.

format.label: Format
format.description: The output format. MP4 only works for animated templates.

modifications.label: Modifications
modifications.description: Element values keyed by element name, e.g. {"title": "Hello", "image": "https://…/photo.jpg"}. Use "<element>.<property>" keys for detailed changes, e.g. {"title.textColor": "red"}. Use List Template Elements to get the keys.

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Output scale from 0.1 to 3. Defaults to 1.

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Compression quality from 10 to 100, JPG only.

dpi.label: DPI
dpi.description: DPI from 1 to 1200, JPG and PNG only.

fps.label: FPS
fps.description: Frames per second for MP4: 24, 30, 50 or 60.

duration.label: Duration
duration.description: Video length in milliseconds for MP4, up to 10000.

robolly_get_render.label: Get Render
robolly_get_render.description: Gets one render by ID, with its status and file URL.

renderId.label: Render ID
renderId.description: The render ID, from List Renders.

robolly_list_renders.label: List Renders
robolly_list_renders.description: Lists past renders, newest first, 30 per page.

templateId.label: Template ID
templateId.description: Only renders of this template. Use List Templates to find it.

movieId.label: Movie ID
movieId.description: Only renders with this movie ID.

cacheHash.label: Cache Hash
cacheHash.description: Only the render with this cache hash.
